extracted.intended_audience: journalists, media organizations, policymakers, and the general public concerned with press freedom (Spain)
extracted.subtask_description: A short federative statement (press-release style) asserting the role of journalism as a pillar of democracy and calling to combat political polarization, hoaxes, and fake news while upholding ethical and professional standards.

rubrics_metrics.name: Defensa del periodismo como pilar fundamental de la democracia
rubrics_metrics.description: La FAPE reitera su compromiso con la defensa del periodismo como pilar fundamental de la democracia.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Affirms the normative role of a free press in democratic society and implies support for measures and behaviors that protect journalistic independence and safety (e.g., legal protections, institutional support, public recognition of press role).

rubrics_metrics.name: Llamamiento a acabar con la crispación generada por la polarización política
rubrics_metrics.description: La Federación hace un llamamiento general para acabar con la crispación generada por la polarización política.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Promotes reducing polarizing rhetoric and social tension; implies favoring dialogue, responsible discourse, and avoiding partisan escalation that undermines public trust in information.

rubrics_metrics.name: No fomentar la difusión de bulos y noticias falsas
rubrics_metrics.description: Acabar con la polarización política que fomenta la difusión de bulos y noticias falsas.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Explicitly condemns hoaxes and fake news; implies that journalists and media outlets should avoid amplifying unverified claims and should actively counter misinformation through verification and correction.

rubrics_metrics.name: Ejercicio de un periodismo veraz
rubrics_metrics.description: La defensa de un periodismo veraz (reporting that is truthful and accurate).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Calls for accuracy, fact-checking and truthful reporting as core quality criteria for journalistic work; anti-patterns include sensationalism, unchecked rumors, and deliberate misinformation.

rubrics_metrics.name: Actuar dentro de principios éticos y profesionales
rubrics_metrics.description: El periodismo veraz enmarcado dentro de los principios éticos y profesionales.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Requires adherence to journalistic ethics and professional standards (e.g., impartiality, transparency about sources and methods, corrections policies); suggests institutional or self-regulatory frameworks to maintain standards.
